title: Modpack translation queue
subtitle: Add several modpacks at once and Moru will run the existing translation pipeline for one pack at a time.

policy.title: Run policy:
policy.body: All packs use the translation settings captured at start and include every category. Failed packs are recorded and skipped; review and export remain available per pack in History.

empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.desc: Select multiple modpack folders to prepare sequential translation.

confirmClear.title: Clear the queue
confirmClear.body: A pack is being translated. Clearing the queue stops it and removes every row. This cannot be undone.

validation.noMods: Skipped because no mods folder was found: {{path}}

error.interruptedScan: The app closed before the modpack scan finished.
error.lostTranslation: The translation job could not be restored after the app restarted.
error.wizardBusy: Another translation is already running. Finish or stop it before starting the queue.
error.interruptedTranslation: The translation was interrupted. Continue it with "Resume translation" in History.

locales.label: Target languages
locales.multi: Each pack is queued once per language ({{count}})
